ops.title: cc-transcript's pytest prints no final \"N passed\" summary line — judge runs by exit code, count dots for tallies
ops.body: In cc-transcript, `uv run pytest -q` emits only progress-dot lines and never a final "N passed in Xs" summary (something in the repo's pytest config/conftest suppresses it, observed 2026-07-16). `grep passed` on the output finds nothing even on a fully green run. Judge pass/fail by exit code; for a count, tally the progress markers (`tr -d -c '.sxF' | wc -c`) or use `--collect-only`.
